blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V149 images shows that grouping all six overskirt panels into one native-cloth solve removes the prior separately simulated shell, but produces extreme ballooning and dense, irregular folds in front, back, three-quarter and pose views. The skirt hem is jagged and its authored pleat silhouette is not readable. This is a visible failure of the unified cloth hypothesis, not a seam-continuity issue.

Pose-matched geometry remains inadequate. Overskirt upper-thigh coverage is 0.263 left / 0.268 right in crouch and 0.169 / 0.173 in sit; the fitted under-shorts cover only 0.642 per side in crouch and 0.638 per side in sit. Direct crouch and sit views expose large block-like thigh-cover surfaces as the skirt lifts and folds away. These measurements are diagnostic only and are not a fit pass.

Angular triangular surface artifacts across the torso and an abrupt waist-to-hip shelf remain visible in front, side, three-quarter, arm-cross and crouch views. This independent appearance defect remains unresolved.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
